rows.title: Staying Power: Clint Eastwood's Million Dollar Baby
rows.comment: finding unchanging beauty in the skull beneath the skin.
rows.verdict_le10: finding unchanging beauty in the skull beneath the skin.
rows.dek_lead: Age has clenched Clint Eastwood’s face tight as a fist, but he has never been more tender, vulnerable, and heartbroken than in Million Dollar Baby. It’s not surprising that the camera still loves Eastwood’s visage, finding unchanging beauty

rows.title: On Clint Eastwood in "Million Dollar Baby" | Festivals & Awards | Roger Ebert
rows.dek_lead: Thanks to Swank, for a patch or two, the strategy works. But then he brings on the brutality and bathos. If any director proves that sadomasochism is just the evil twin of sentimentality, it’s Eastwood in “Million Dollar Baby.” — Michael Sr
